cv.name: Henrik Aaltonen
cv.summary: Maintenance planner with **eleven years** in paper mills and food plants. I plan shutdowns that finish on time, keep spare parts honest and write work orders technicians can follow.

roles.title: Maintenance Planner
bullets: Planned four annual shutdowns of 12 days each with 300 contractors on site.
Cut emergency work orders from **35% to 18%** by moving routine checks into the weekly plan.
Set up the spare parts min/max levels in SAP PM with the stores team.
Trained six new planners on the work order process.

roles.title: Maintenance Technician
bullets: Repaired filling and packing lines across two shifts.
Wrote step-by-step lockout guides for every line.

cv.skills: SAP PM, shutdown planning, reliability-centred maintenance

cv.name: Lucía Ferrer Vidal
cv.summary:
Head chef with twelve years in hotel and restaurant kitchens across Spain.
I like calm services, clear prep lists and menus built around the season.
- Food cost and supplier negotiations.
- Training young cooks.

roles.title: Head Chef
bullets: Run a kitchen of 14 cooks serving 220 covers a night in summer.
Rewrote the menu every season with local suppliers; food cost fell from 34% to 29%.
Trained two sous chefs who now run their own kitchens.

roles.title: Sous Chef
bullets: Ran the breakfast and banquet service for up to 400 guests.
Kept HACCP records ready for every inspection.

cv.skills: Menu planning, food cost, HACCP, team training
